Appreciate the data. Jonas and I sketched a concrete amendment you can use to run this internally. High-level commercial proposal: 

1) Term & commit
- 12 months, effective Jan 1 2027.
- Base commit: increase current committed tokens by 30% (est. 550M tokens/year).

2) Pricing & discounts
- Base price: $18 / 1M tokens on committed usage.
- Overage tiers: $24 / 1M until 1.5x commit, $32 / 1M beyond that.
- Volume discount: 15% applied on monthly billed overage if overage > 20% of commit.

3) Operational & SLA
- Option to enable Dedicated pool (+30% monthly infra premium) with reserved capacity and talk to Support for runbook playbook.
- Latency credit: partial credit applied when p95 > 300ms for >48 hours; full credit mech in draft amendment.

I've attached a redline (signed_amendment_draft_v2.pdf) that reflects these points. Please review and let us know edits. We're flexible on ramping the commit over Q1 if you prefer a 2-step ramp to reduce upfront spend.

If useful, we can prepare an itemized cost-per-1M tokens spreadsheet for the ramp scenarios.
